# Model for leveraged-ETF exposure rebalancing

A concept shared by **4** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #8,427. ## Description

Proposed model for leveraged-ETF exposure rebalancing: Adjust exposure to maintain a specified leveraged-ETF allocation or target exposure, while accounting for daily-reset effects, path dependency, and transaction costs. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
